P a g e  | 79 
 
Annexure – V 
 
SELF CERTIFICATION/UNDERATKING BY THE BIDDER 
I/We, ________________________________________, authorized representative of M/s 
________________________________________, hereby certify and undertake that: 
1. I/We have visited the site of the proposed work and inspected the site and its surroundings 
before submission of our bid. 
2. I/We have carefully examined and familiarized ourselves with the site conditions, existing 
structures, access to the site, working conditions, availability of working space, approach 
roads, site constraints, existing services/utilities, storage facilities,  and other relevant 
physical conditions which may affect the execution of the work. 
3. I/We have taken into account all such site conditions and constraints while quoting our rates. 
No additional claim on account of lack of knowledge or unfamiliarity with the site conditions 
shall be entertained after award of the work. 
4. I/We understand that submission of this Self -Certification/Undertaking is a confirmation 
that we have personally inspected the site and familiarized ourselves with all relevant 
conditions before submitting the tender. 
Accordingly, I/We hereby certify that the above information is true and correct and undertake to 
abide by the conditions stated above and the provisions of the NIT/Tender Document. 
Place: ____________________  
Date: _____________________ 
Signature of Authorized Signatory: __________________________ 
Name: _________________________________________________ 
Designation: ____________________________________________ 
Name of Firm/Agency: ____________________________________ 
Seal of the Firm/Agency

ANNEXURE V — CERTIFICATIONS AND ACCREDITATIONS HELD
Bidder : Jharkhand Constructions
Tender ref : eTender Notice No. CMU-12011/17/2026-CMU
Work : Construction of boundary wall of approximate length 300 metre at Part of IIT (ISM)
Campus, Dhanbad
Contents of this annexure
The documents comprised in this annexure are listed below. Each is a true copy
of the original, self-attested by our authorised signatory. The originals will be
produced for verification at any time on the demand of the Employer.
1. Certifications and accreditations held — principal document
2. Certifications and accreditations held — supporting correspondence
3. Certifications and accreditations held — attestation by authorised signatory
Certification
We certify that the documents reproduced in this annexure are true copies of the
originals in our possession, that none of them has been altered in any respect,
and that all of them are valid and subsisting as on the date of submission of
this bid.
For Jharkhand Constructions
(Authorised Signatory)
Date : 22.08.2026

affected_vendors.status: Answer key says pass; stored enclosure list has no required self-certification. Actual Annexure V is certifications/accreditations, not the notification form. Requires source/fixture reconciliation; no expected status or bid content changed.
